open_questions: These are 10 of the 'notified' Lahore bus routes as they existed in October 2010; almost all were displaced by the Metrobus (2013) and the Speedo feeder network. Status in 2026 is unknown - import as unverified historical context only.
The LUTMP road inventory survey counted 373 bus stops across 2,233 km of Lahore road network (Vol II Table 1.2.13) but the stop inventory itself is not published in either volume.
The route numbering here (4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 16, 17, 19, 22, 33) is a third numbering scheme, different from both the PMA IPTN feeder numbers and the current Speedo RT-xx codes.
No JICA GIS data annex or shapefile is published with either volume.
